subject: Cloudforge: post-discovery recap & proposed technical deep-dive slots
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Zhao <ezhao@cloudforge.com>, Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@cloudforge.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-21T16:24:00-08:00
Subject: Cloudforge: post-discovery recap & proposed technical deep-dive slots

Thanks again for a productive discovery call earlier, Ethan/Priya — good to meet you both. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a date for the technical deep-dive: 

Summary (short):
- Key priority: integrate Redwood inference into Cloudforge Marketplace offering; primary use case is customer-facing feature that needs sub-200ms tail latency for 512-token requests.
- Data residency: EU customers will require private deployment option (VPC).
- Success criteria: throughput 100 QPS sustained, predictable cost per 1k tokens, and SOC2 evidence for the marketplace listing.

Proposed next step: 90-minute technical deep-dive to include solutions engineering, infra sizing, and integration handoffs. Ben (cc'd) will lead technical content.

Please indicate availability for any of these slots (PST):
- Tue Nov 28, 09:00-10:30 or 13:00-14:30
- Wed Nov 29, 11:00-12:30
- Thu Nov 30, 08:30-10:00 or 15:00-16:30

If none of those work, propose 2 alternatives and we'll align. I've uploaded a lightweight mutual action plan and intake notes to the Drive link below.

Attachments: redwood-muth-action-plan.xlsx (outline + owners), cloudforge-tech-intake-notes.pdf (call notes)

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Schedule: https://cal.redwood.com/jordan_blake
From: Ethan Zhao <ezhao@cloudforge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@cloudforge.com>
Date: 2028-11-21T18:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cloudforge: post-discovery recap & proposed technical deep-dive slots

Thanks Jordan — good call. Priya and I reviewed the summary and this aligns with our internal priorities. Quick answers: 

- EU data residency: yes, we'll want the VPC/private deployment conversation in scope.
- Latency target: sub-200ms sounds right for us for the demo; we can stress test later.

Slot preferences (in order):
1) Wed Nov 29, 11:00-12:30 PST (best)
2) Tue Nov 28, 13:00-14:30 PST

Also looping in our Platform PM (Priya) who will own follow-ups on the marketplace listing. If Ben can share a short agenda, we'll make sure our infra and security folks can join the relevant sections.

Ethan

Perfect — Wed Nov 29, 11:00-12:30 PST is locked tentatively. Ben, can you confirm availability and drop the agenda/attachments? Camila, will start a shared invite and include suggested attendee list for security and platform folks on the Cloudforge side.

Action items: 
- Ben: tech agenda + doc attach (15m)
- Camila: calendar invite + attendee list (by EOD MT)
- Jordan: finalize MAP owners in spreadsheet

I'll convert the tentative to confirmed once Ben posts agenda.

Best,
Jordan
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Ethan Zhao <ezhao@cloudforge.com>, Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@cloudforge.com>
Date: 2028-11-22T08:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cloudforge: post-discovery recap & proposed technical deep-dive slots

Thanks — I'm available Wed Nov 29 11:00-12:30 PST and have attached a concise agenda (technical-deepdive-agenda.pdf). Proposed flow:

- 0-10m: Introductions + goals
- 10-30m: Redwood architecture overview (serving runtime + routing)
- 30-60m: Scalability & sizing for 100 QPS, latency SLOs, and quantization options
- 60-80m: Integration checklist for marketplace (auth, billing hooks, listing artifacts)
- 80-90m: Next actions & owner assignments

Notes: I'll bring a quick perf slide with our 512-token baseline and expected throughput with batching. For EU residency questions we should reserve the last 10 minutes for Camila to walk proposed Private deployment patterns.

Attachments: technical-deepdive-agenda.pdf

—Ben

Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Confirmed on our side — Wed Nov 29, 11:00-12:30 PST. I've added our infra lead (matt.lang@cloudforge.com) to the calendar invite Camila will send. We'll review Ben's agenda ahead of time and flag any additional artifacts we need. Looking forward.

Best,
Priya Kapoor
Platform Product Manager | Cloudforge Systems
